cells.gaps: Everything held dates from 2018: nothing inside the 36 months for governance or the 12 months for change. The 807 of 1,848 schools are connected to School-Link, not shown entering data, and cover all levels with no primary split; daily attendance entry is established only for a 103-school pilot. NAM-004 (routine) and NAM-007 (most schools on paper registers) disagree on how the record is kept. NAM-001 is from the excluded source and sets nothing.
cells.note: School-Link, with its learner unit record module, is described as the live national system and 807 schools are connected, so it is past a pilot in some primary schools. Stage 4 fails: the count is of schools connected, under half of the total, and attendance entry was a pilot.
